senses.gloss: m. (ὑδρωπικόν or ὑδερικόν, sub. πάθος) dropsy; (חולה) ה׳ one afflicted with dropsy.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 41b:18">Erub. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>חיה וחולי מעיים וה׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="H00672"><he>חיה</he></cite> misplaced, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) a lying-in woman, and sufferers from bowel diseases or dropsy.
<cite ref="Shabbat 33a:13">Sabb. 33ᵃ</cite> (Ms. M. <cite ref="E00169"><he>הִדְרָקוֹן</he></cite>); a. e. [Ar. reads everywhere <cite ref="E00169"><he>הדרקון</he></cite>.]
